# RBS GROUP

> > RBS GROUP delivers premium resin bound surfaces, stone carpets, and rubber flooring solutions across the UAE, specializing in driveways, pathways, slope protection, and commercial installations.

Based in Business Bay, Dubai, RBS GROUP has completed landmark projects including Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, EXPO 2020 UAE Pavilion, and numerous residential and commercial developments. The company specializes in permeable paving, erosion control, and temperature-resistant flooring solutions compliant with LEED and ADA standards.
